originality.rationale: Songyun Xu (2008) Chapter 2 §2.1 explicitly gives a COMPLETE classification of ALL pairs of intersecting lines on the Fermat quintic, using Types I–III by their intersection position (thesis pp. 5–7), and includes the 50 cones and 375 distinguished lines. Restricting this stronger full-line intersection classification to the 375 special lines fixes exactly the 375-vertex adjacency relation, with two-/four-coordinate incidence determined by the given parametrized line formulas; graph statistics and cliques are determined from that prior incidence. Thus the claimed independent original ambient-intersection classification is a special-case combinatorial recasting of an earlier dominating classification, although the numerical graph/click invariants are not explicitly printed in the thesis. Reject the full claim for originality, without claiming that Xu printed 1875 or the clique maximum.
residual_risks: The explicit maximum-clique/common-neighbor classification is not printed in Xu; its independent graph-theoretic utility does not remove the earlier full pair relation as stronger art.
Do not conflate projective-line intersections with intersections of parameter curves in the Fano scheme.
